sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。

sentences.en: Today I'm going to talk about my trip to New York. The whole entire story from the moment.
sentences.tc: 今天我要談談我的紐約之旅。整個故事從那一刻開始。

sentences.en: I arrived at the airport to my home in Nebraska to New York and back in Mexico City.
sentences.tc: 我抵達機場，前往內布拉斯加州的家，飛往紐約，然後返回墨西哥城。

sentences.en: In the morning, my family and I woke up at around 4 a.m. Super early because my dad had to drive us to the airport.

sentences.en: They're so big.

sentences.en: They're unnecessarily big with almost no cars, just roads. I can't imagine walking somewhere in the United States. Right away, my aunt took us all to eat ice cream.

sentences.en: We all used to live in Sue City and it brought back so many nostalgic feelings. So many warm memories. I walked around the streets in Sous City with my sister.
sentences.tc: 我們都曾經住在蘇城，它給我們帶來了很多懷舊的感覺。這麼多溫暖的回憶。我和姐姐一起在Sous市的街道上散步。

sentences.en: We saw all of the old houses that.
sentences.tc: 我們看到了所有的老房子。

sentences.en: We were little. There's nothing like that nostalgic feeling of being in your childhood home or childhood city.
sentences.tc: 我們還小。沒有什麼比回到兒時的家或兒時的城市更讓人懷念的感覺了。

sentences.en: What place brings back nostalgic feelings for you? What things bring back nostalgic feelings? For me, it's all of the green trees and the big houses and even the big roads?
